description: The IC Inspector's shape-sphere point n on random ICs, for kernel::shape's cross-check (REQ-CHART-018, REQ-CHART-036). Each number is its binary64 bits in hex. raw: Randomise-distributed ICs, canonicalised by the inspector; n is the canonical (upper-hemisphere) representative, bc_azimuth collisionPhi's azimuths of BC01, BC12 and BC02. decoded: latent vectors on [-3, 3]^8 through its decode.
